journey.name: wear restore ambient hides word
journey.description:
In ambient mode the word screen of the restore shows nothing: the field and the suggestion chips are replaced by an empty screen, and waking the watch brings the typed letters back. Ambient mode keeps the app on screen, so the words stay; leaving the app drops them (`restore-background-drops-words.xml`). Emulator and physical watch (on a watch, lowering the wrist or covering the screen with a palm does the same as `KEYCODE_SLEEP`).
Precondition: Fresh app, see journeys/wear/README.md › Fresh app, and the always-on screen on (README › Watch gestures). Backend: none, the journey stops before the wallet connects. The word screens block screenshots, so check them with `android layout` only.

actions.action: Type `ab` into "RestoreWordInput" without pressing Enter (README › Typing, steps 2 and 3)
Run `adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP` and wait 3 s
Run `adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/ui.xml && adb shell grep -c RestoreHidden /sdcard/ui.xml` and verify it prints 1 (README: `android layout` leaves out a node with no text)
Run `adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP` and wait 2 s
